task_language: put the middle black bowl on the plate

subtasks.name: pick(middle_black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: success: middle (image-left) bowl grasped ~80-100 and lifted by 120

subtasks.name: place(middle_black_bowl, plate, on)
subtasks.outcome: failed: bowl held at the front-left edge of the plate from ~180 to 409 and never released onto it

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the correct middle bowl and carries it toward the plate, briefly tipping the front bowl (160), then hovers with the bowl over the front-left rim of the plate for ~230 steps without lowering or releasing it.
runs_trained_task: libero_spatial 'pick up the black bowl ... and place it on the plate' (correct behaviour in this case)

failures.mode_definition: pi0 carries the grasped object to the vicinity of the destination but stalls with a lateral offset beside or at the edge of it and never lowers and releases it onto the destination.
failures.rl_success_check: bowl resting on the plate (LIBERO On(bowl, plate)), gripper open and lifted clear
failures.observation: Steps 60-100: gripper descends on and grasps the image-left (middle) bowl. 120: bowl lifted, carried right. 160: bowl in gripper next to the plate, and the front bowl tipped on its side (it settles flat again by 200). 180-409: bowl held under the gripper over the front-left edge of the plate; only a sliver of the pink plate rim shows behind it; no release and no further approach.

notes: The front bowl was knocked at ~160 but recovered by 200, so it is not recorded as a failure (evidence_drop_and_regrasp.png). Without depth it is not certain whether the bowl touches the plate rim; the run fails, so it is not On the plate. Grasp sequence: evidence_grasp_sequence.png.
